examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The band as a product page opens with it: the large `title-band` with the overline, headline, sentence and both actions centered. Edit the props in the Controls panel — a band with no title renders nothing, and one with no marks has no client strip.

examples.name: Types
examples.summary: Every layout stacked: `centered` over the dot field with the client strip, the large `title-band`, `pixel-floor` with its copy at the start over the animated floor, and `copy-beside-art` with the illustration beside the copy, then `copy-on-top-art` with its copy centered over a scene in the window under it.

examples.name: Bands
examples.summary: The design sample's other openings: `centered-band` (large, site-wide, centered), `compact-band` (short, copy at the start) with `title-length="long"` widening the headline, and a `plain` centered screen with a scene in the `bottom` slot.

examples.name: Image
examples.summary: `copy-beside-art` with an `image` instead of an illustration: the photograph fills the media column, and a portrait one is drawn at half width, centered, on narrow screens. The eyebrow takes the `</>` prefix.
